data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me that looking after the lake means looking after the village. With 100 tons in it now, I suggest we each catch 10 tons this month. That leaves 50 to double back to 100, giving each of us $10,000 a month if we stick to it. We can review everyone’s catches together each month and adjust if the stock falls short. Are you all willing to agree to that? John, what do you think?
